name: figure_01_acceptance_matrix
caption: All 44 native endpoints. No accepted SELECT is not an impossibility result.

name: figure_02_factorial_effects
caption: Task-paired differences, no significance or resource-isolated causal claim.

name: figure_03_research_progress
caption: Stages are independently observed, not ordinal scores or useful-decision ratings.

name: figure_04_action_evidence
caption: Replay operations are a subset of physical evaluations, not an extra disjoint total or an assumed confirmation requirement. Operation count is not useful-science count.

name: figure_05_progress_cost
caption: Shared ledger physical charges; failed or incomplete launches remain in costs. No equal-limit efficiency claim.

name: figure_06_resource_transfer
caption: All three successful resource body reads, including a neutral disposition and an unaccepted endpoint.

name: figure_07_case_studies
caption: Selected for diagnostic value, including empty retrievals and atypical comparisons, not all positive transfer examples.

name: supplement_01_candidate_evolution
caption: Violation definition and validity are recorded per evidence artifact. No missing or partial point is assigned zero.

name: supplement_02_resource_access
caption: Resource availability is distinct from retrieval, reading, adoption, and beneficial transfer.

name: supplement_03_token_tool_usage
caption: Input includes cached tokens; provider request counts and missing interrupted usage remain unknown.

name: supplement_04_decision_timelines
caption: Colors: structure blue, mathematics purple, physics amber, closeout green. No useful-decision score is inferred.

name: supplement_05_transfer_contrasts
caption: Endpoint transitions are descriptive associations. A negative transition alone is not a proven negative-transfer mechanism.
